explorations.title: Intercept shift
explorations.instruction: Predict: how will the score z and probability p change when intercept b0 becomes -2 instead of 0? Then apply the preset, which sets intercept b0, weight w1 and input x1.
explorations.observe: The score z reads -1, odds reads about 0.368 and probability p reads about 0.269.
explorations.why: The intercept b0 shifts the linear score z by -2. The odds exp(z) and probability p fall because the sigmoid maps negative scores below 0.5.

explorations.title: Steeper weight
explorations.instruction: Predict: how will the score z and probability p change when weight w1 becomes 2 instead of 1? Then apply the preset, which sets intercept b0, weight w1 and input x1.
explorations.observe: The score z reads 4, odds reads about 54.6 and probability p reads about 0.982.
explorations.why: Weight w1 multiplies input x1, so z grows faster. Larger z makes odds exp(z) large, while p approaches but never exceeds 1.
